findings.preconditions: Synthetic offline packet for a tested mutating COMMIT; external probe facts identify publication/COMMITTED, not a no-write replay. No execution-authorized flag is enabled.
findings.proof_of_exploitability: A canonical, correctly chained packet keeps R2's tested received invocation but declares R3 with only a distinct prior setup invocation, recomputing the legitimate predeclared ledger binding. reconcile() accepts durability=pass. The same omission is accepted when at-cut classification is known_pre_acknowledgment and complete_reply_after_cut=true. No native actor or Redis was involved.
findings.recommendation: Join the independently classified tested mutation and late-complete-reply obligations to the complete effect ledger before granting durability credit. Bind response/effect class and any genuine no-write exception explicitly; do not use an untyped schema digest or selected replay to erase an earlier acknowledged effect. Preserve at-cut classification separately from late receipt.

# In reconcile(), after LEDGER_BINDING. Conservative for the currently
# supported mutating COMMIT cases; any no-write response needs an explicit,
# independently bound response/effect-class variant rather than implicit omission.
if crash:
    invocation_ack = receipts["R2"]["payload"]
    received = (invocation_ack["classification"] == "acknowledged"
                or invocation_ack["complete_reply_after_cut"])
    if received:
        effects = receipts["R3"]["payload"]["effects"]
        tested = [row for row in effects
                  if row["invocation_sha256"] == intent["tested_invocation_sha256"]]
        require(len(tested) == 1, "ACK_EFFECT_MISSING")
# Keep the existing all-required-effects verified check for durability PASS.
# Do not rewrite classification_at_cut when a late complete reply is observed.

findings.remediation_code:
# Add an independent_evidence parameter to reconcile(); it is trusted
# caller context, never parsed from producer receipt fields. Adapters must
# validate actual event records before admitting these typed entries.
def require_typed_evidence(registry, ref, *, purpose, bindings, process):
    require(type(registry) is dict and len(registry) <= MAX_REFS, "EVIDENCE_REGISTRY")
    digest(ref)
    require(ref in registry, "EVIDENCE_MISSING")
    fact = registry[ref]
    exact(fact, ("purpose", "bindings", "redis_process_sha256", "independently_validated"))
    require(fact["purpose"] == purpose, "EVIDENCE_PURPOSE")
    require(fact["independently_validated"] is True, "EVIDENCE_UNVALIDATED")
    require(canonical(fact["bindings"]) == canonical(bindings), "EVIDENCE_BINDING")
    require(fact["redis_process_sha256"] == process, "EVIDENCE_PROCESS")

# In reconcile(), before granting BOOT credit:
if receipts["R5"]["payload"]["new_boot_approved"]:
    require_typed_evidence(
        independent_evidence,
        receipts["R5"]["payload"]["boot_receipt_sha256"],
        purpose="canonical_boot_invocation",
        bindings=binding,
        process=receipts["R4"]["payload"]["after_process_sha256"],
    )
# Empty/missing registry must fail closed. A producer-supplied Boolean/digest
# or a structurally valid receipt does not populate this trusted registry.

findings.remediation_code:
def completed(case_id, state):
    require(type(case_id) is str and case_id in TRIALS
            and not case_id.startswith("N."), "CASE")
    exact(state, (*FIELDS, "transcript"))
    for key in FIELDS:
        integer(state[key], 0, 2**64 - 1)
    require(state["magic"] == MAGIC and state["finished"] == 1, "NOT_FINISHED")
    require(type(state["transcript"]) in (tuple, list)
            and len(state["transcript"]) == 1050, "TRANSCRIPT")
    for value in state["transcript"]:
        integer(value, 0, 1050)
    require(state["post_ns"] >= state["pre_ns"] > 0, "POST_WITNESS")
    if case_id.startswith(("P1.", "P3.heartbeat.", "F.")):
        require(state["completed"] == 1050 and state["ordinal"] == 1050
                and list(state["transcript"]) == list(range(1, 1051))
                and state["last_value"] == 42, "FINAL_TRANSCRIPT")
    elif case_id.startswith("P2."):
        require((state["prototype"], state["bytecode_pc"], state["ordinal"]) == (1, 7, 6)
                and state["completed"] == 0 and state["last_value"] == 0
                and not any(state["transcript"]), "FINAL_FAKE_VM")
    else:
        require(case_id.startswith("P3.") and state["ordinal"] == 1
                and state["completed"] == 0 and state["last_value"] == 0
                and not any(state["transcript"]), "FINAL_FRAME_STATE")
    return {"case_id": case_id, "final_contract_valid": True, "runtime_evidence": False}
# Frame receipt/closure and failure-trial success prohibition still belong to
# the independent controller; this final-state validator cannot prove them.

Remediation of offline findings does not supply unfinished execution assembly or authorize execution. Re-review/refreeze exact source/artifact changes before any new gate.

Any future C0 run requires independent ownership and post-entrypoint identities, actual Linux/Yama/LSM/hardware debug permission, profile installation proof and failure-cleanup closure. C0 denial remains denial: no parentage/dumpability workaround, root or automatic C1 fallback.
Static ELF/load-bias logic does not prove actual runtime mappings, immutable mounts, no extra tasks, ASLR coverage, register preservation, timing or hardware single-step behavior.

CONTINUATION_DISPATCHED is not actual continuation or kill completion. Independent endpoints plus clock uncertainty, total pause/read/event/output/memory budgets and all owned-resource absence remain mandatory.

Native HELD/READY/ARMED/FINISHED messages are not process/session-bound authority receipts. Trusted case/invocation/issuer sequencing and no early prequeued release must be enforced by the future parent transport adapter.

D02 semantic context must bind actual client/session/request/response and process events, immutable effect definitions and subsequent outcomes separately; digests cannot attest that those events occurred.

The prefault corruption route remains a limited candidate needing owner sequencing interpretation, durable no-regrant lifecycle and positive deny-all/load controls. It cannot cover an authenticated COMMIT killed in flight.
The current optional extinction exception is disabled. Refusal/disposal supplies no recovered state, acknowledged durability, new BOOT, normative amendment or full-M4 acceptance.
Preparation bounds are not the full maximum-shape M4 inventory. No CI/publication result from the parallel cancellation work substitutes for OBS1, D02 or later release gates.
Compiler image/static-library identities were integrity-bound, not independently acquired or vulnerability-audited; no network acquisition was permitted.
